parts.text: State Coulomb's law for the force between two point charges.

parts.text:
Two point charges are situated in a vacuum and separated by a distance $R$. The force between the charges is $F_C$.

On Fig. 5.1, sketch a graph to show the variation of the force $F$ between the charges with separation $x$ for values of $x$ from $x = R$ to $x = 4R$.
